title: AI Creator Story LAB: Studio Reel
description: The official cinematic studio showreel and creative introduction for AI Creator Story LAB by Arun Chakravarti, exploring evocative neural storytelling, high-fidelity AI-generated visuals, and commercial direction.
creativeDirection: Dynamic cinematic pacing, atmospheric lighting, high-concept world-building, and immersive sound design.

title: Velora 2: Cinematic Production
description: A high-concept commercial and cinematic visual piece featuring fluid AI motion synthesis, glossy reflections, dynamic camera trajectories, and futuristic product aesthetics.
creativeDirection: High-contrast commercial lighting, kinetic camera sweeps, and futuristic color grading.

title: Chronicles of Aethelgard: The Lost Beacon
description: An evocative sci-fi epic set across a dying star cluster. Exploring human legacy, digital consciousness, and cosmic scale through custom-prompted cinematic scenes, atmospheric particle physics, and fluid motion design.
creativeDirection: Anamorphic 2.39:1 widescreen, moody cyan and deep slate color grade, atmospheric particulate lighting, and slow orchestral tension.
role: AI Director, Prompt Architect & Sound Designer

title: Aura Lumina: The Future of Scent
description: A speculative luxury fragrance commercial celebrating synthetic botanicals and translucent neon glass. Designed for social discovery and luxury broadcast with hyper-detailed fluid simulations.
creativeDirection: Glossy macro reflections, fluid physics, crystalline refraction, and hyper-precise cinematic lighting.

title: The Glass Horizon: Cliffside Sanctuary
description: Architectural marketing film for a conceptual cantilevered coastal estate. Showcasing dawn-to-dusk lighting transitions, infinity pool reflections, and minimalist interior styling.
creativeDirection: Golden hour and twilight contrasts, smooth Steadicam-style AI sweeping motions, and spatial harmony.

title: Kroma Velocity: Electric Hypercar
description: A dynamic adrenaline-infused reveal commercial for an electric hypercar concept cutting through rain-slicked Tokyo highways with aerodynamic vortex trails.
creativeDirection: High-contrast neon reflections, motion blur, aerodynamic vortex trails, and pulsing bass rhythm.

title: Mira Valen: Cybernetic Lookbook
description: Editorial fashion series featuring an AI virtual model showcasing futuristic streetwear, metallic fabrics, and holographic accessories with persistent character fidelity.
creativeDirection: Studio portraiture, soft rim lighting, tactile fabric physics, and consistent character LoRA tuning.

title: The Memory Foundry
description: A poetic manifesto film exploring how human memories are captured, distilled, and reimagined through artificial intelligence, bridging analog nostalgia and computational beauty.
creativeDirection: Warm sepia tones juxtaposed against electric cyan memories, analog film grain, and deliberate pacing.
